name: Silver Age (Lee/Kirby/Thomas)
description: X-Men #1 (1963) through the original run's cancellation at #66. The first five students and the founding Xavier/Magneto conflict.

name: Claremont Era
description: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (1975) through Chris Claremont's departure after X-Men #3 (1991). The all-new team, Phoenix, Days of Future Past, the Brood, Inferno.

name: 90s / Blue-Gold
description: Jim Lee's X-Men relaunch through the Onslaught and Apocalypse: The Twelve era. Rogue and Gambit, the Blue and Gold teams, Age of Apocalypse.

name: Morrison / Whedon Era
description: New X-Men (2001–2004) and Astonishing X-Men (2004–2008). Emma Frost joins, Jean dies, the school becomes a school.

name: Utopia / Schism
description: The X-Men move to San Francisco and then the island Utopia; Cyclops and Wolverine split the team; Avengers vs. X-Men.

name: Bendis to Gold/Blue
description: All-New X-Men and the time-displaced originals, Death of X, the Gold/Blue era and the Rogue–Gambit wedding.

name: Krakoan Age
description: House of X / Powers of X (2019) through Fall of the House of X (2024). Mutant nation-state on the living island Krakoa; resurrection; the Quiet Council.

name: From the Ashes
description: Post-Krakoa relaunch (July 2024 onward). Teams scattered across Alaska, New York and elsewhere.
